meta.name: Cannibal Poet
meta.description: A three-part miniseries investigating the case of José Luis Calva Zepeda, a notorious serial killer accused of cannibalizing his girlfriend.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Journalist Luis Brito begins his investigation into the notorious "Cannibal Poet," leading him to uncover another potential victim.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Brito interviews Calva's sister, who describes a traumatic childhood, and later, talks with an alleged accomplice in Verónica's murder.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: A key figure recounts the plan to track down Calva. After his arrest, authorities soon began linking Calva to other unsolved cases.
